svg.title: Weighted W state at the midpoint
svg.desc: The exact pure state is sqrt(2/7)|100> plus sqrt(2/7)|010> plus sqrt(3/7)|001>. Bar heights show the squared amplitudes 2/7,2/7,3/7. The state is a coherent superposition, not a classical mixture.

g.text: Coherent pure-state superposition · Bars show probabilities
